overall.verdict: A visually coherent, trust-forward mobile wallet whose one-scale bar system and 'enforceable right now' framing are genuinely differentiated. Its weaknesses are protocol jargon leaking into consumer flows and several task-critical screens (dispute, desk, detail) absent from the set.
priority_fixes: Translate or demote protocol jargon (entity id, frames, lazy entity, bps, lanes, collateral tariff) across receive, move, ownership, and swap screens
Promote 'Enforceable right now' to Home as the headline safety number with a link to Sovereignty
Reconcile every displayed number set (120 vs 180, credit line vs receive capacity, 'nothing at risk' vs Promised $90) to single sources of truth
Make receipts forwardable/shareable with a full proof hash and copy affordances for Sofia and Ravi
Add and capture the missing dispute flow, Desk view, and transaction detail screens
